scope: 0.2.0 Mac Apple Silicon simulator preview preparation; dependency sources below remain the previous release baseline
invariants: The published Culsma 1.0.8 wheel must not satisfy the OS dependency
Compatibility wheels have PEP 440 local version labels derived from exact source commits
Snapshot builds use immutable committed sources and change distribution metadata only
OS tests own all required test inputs; installed plugins need no sibling source checkout
Clean runs import from non-editable wheels, with no PYTHONPATH or source-path injection
The wheel, sdist, entry points, and Python 3.11/3.12 profiles must be verified separately
Validation runs locally, with no GitHub Actions; the public release provides anonymous download URLs and fixed hashes

release.scope: Self-contained macOS arm64 simulator app with isolated MCP bridge; Python archives and fixed dependency wheels
blocking_requirements: Freeze accepted language separation-context changes into an immutable source commit
Freeze the matching Opentrons adapter, including instrument discovery, and align its language dependency with the accepted language version
Rebuild compatibility wheels and refresh project pins, desktop lock and hashed requirements together
Run clean installed-product acceptance with the exact candidate wheels before publication
